label: SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT DATA (synthetic_dev). Fictional participants from a hand-written simulator; not real people, not learned physiology, not clinical evidence.
simulator_truth: kept outside this directory on purpose; never a model input
assumptions: Hand-written simulator; parameters are illustrative, not fitted to any human data.
CGM nominal 5-min cadence on a per-participant clock offset; values rounded and clipped to 40-400 mg/dL like a consumer CGM display.
~1.5% random CGM dropouts plus one deterministic signal-loss block per participant.

Logged meal times differ from true times by 0-8 min; logged macros carry ~8% self-report noise; some fiber/calorie labels are missing; synthetic_p005 logs snacks as carbs only; synthetic_p006 logs only 3 of its meals (unlogged meals still move glucose); one synthetic_p003 meal has no nutrition logged.
Some days include a snack 45-90 min after lunch, producing overlapping meal responses.
Heart rate: 5-min samples, ~4% missing; synthetic_p005 has no heart-rate or activity data at all.
Medications are recorded events with NO simulated physiological effect.
No meal images exist; image_ref is null everywhere.
